admission.pid_reuse: same PID with different process token becomes UNKNOWN

issuance: Verify final activation flag and all eight exact authority/review pins.
Verify immutable template sources and rehash both pinned provider binaries without execution.
Capture internal system UTC between two monotonic reads; deny rollback or excessive pair span.
Generate fresh opaque block/window/job/slot/attempt/operation IDs internally.
Build one immutable receipt with shared start/deadline and four fixed admission deadlines.
At exact fixed owner-private root, full-write and fsync a 0600 stage, fsync parent, reopen and hash.
No-replace publish receipt, fsync parent, reopen and hash; then no-replace publish and fsync commit marker last.
Never extend, reissue, or replay any complete or incomplete namespace.

public_api.issue_live_window(): zero-argument hard-disabled before clock, ID generation, binary rehash, or I/O
public_api.prepare_window_template(): zero-argument exact source-pin verification; no write
public_api.recover_live_window(): zero-argument exact fixed-root committed receipt recovery; never mint/repair

recovery.commit_authority: valid 0600 marker plus exact receipt bytes/hash
recovery.committed: return exact receipt; never generate identifiers

time_semantics.deadline_edges: inclusive at exact deadline; deny at first later nanosecond
time_semantics.drift: abs(observed UTC - (start UTC + monotonic elapsed)) <= 1 second
